title: Protocol for delivery of macromolecules using dfTAT into live cells
protocol: Seed cells (HeLa, HDF, etc.) in a dish (e.g., 8 well or 24 well dish).
Grow cells in appropriate medium (e.g., DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS and Pen/Strep) until 80-90% confluency in a 37°C humidified atmosphere containing 5% CO2.
Make a 5 µM working concentration of dfTAT by diluting dfTAT in nrL-15 media (for an 8 well dish, the total volume should be 200 µL).
Incubate cells with dfTAT with or without cargo (e.g., EGFP, TAT-Cre etc.) and keep at 37°C for 1h.
Wash cells with heparin (1 mg/ml) in L-15 (3 washes are recommended).
Incubate cells with cell-impermeable nuclear stain such as Sytox Blue or Sytox Green (2 µM in nrL-15) to determine whether the plasma membrane of cells is compromised.
Image cells using a fluorescence microscope (100X oil immersion or 20X objective).
Image dfTAT using a RFP filter (Ex = 560 ± 20 nm/Em = 630 ± 35 nm).
Assess successful delivery by observing diffuse fluorescence of dfTAT throughout the cell.
Stain nucleoli with fTAT to indicate intracellular entry.
Monitor degradation of fTAT within a few hours, noting punctate distribution as an indication of degradation fragments.
